title: Visa & Immigration Manager
description:
Visa & Immigration Manager

Department: Government Engagement & Stakeholder Relations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to both the Head of Government and Host City Management and Manager of Government and Host City Management, the Visa & Immigration Manager will serve as the primary liaison between the FIFA 2027 team, an external immigration service provider, and government authorities involved in visa and immigration processes. The position will be based in the Headquarters at Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

The role will be responsible for supporting the coordination and operational delivery of streamlined and compliant visa procedures for FIFA workforce, delegates, PMAs, VIPs, and guests for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. This position will work closely with internal stakeholders and government entities to ensure clear communication, aligned processes, and efficient case handling.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinating the day‑to‑day execution of visa and immigration processes for all FIFA constituent groups, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and adherence to timelines.
  • Acting as the central point of contact for the external immigration provider, monitoring service quality, documentation standards, and operational performance.
  • Providing guidance on immigration requirements, documentation needs, and expected processing timelines to internal teams and relevant clients, such as workforce, officials, VIPs, Participating Member Association, and other stakeholders.
  • Assisting in compliance activities, including monitoring regulatory changes, ensuring procedural adherence, and escalating risks or complex cases when needed.
  • Supporting interactions with government bodies and consulates by preparing documentation, consolidating information, and facilitating responses to official inquiries.
  • Maintaining updated records, and case‑tracking tools to ensure visibility of progress, bottlenecks, and pending tasks.
  • Preparing operational and financial reports related to immigration services, including cost summaries and monthly reconciliations.
  • Developing and maintaining a network of contacts within government entities, consulates, and immigration‑related institutions.
  • Participating in meetings, workshops, and events when required.
  • Providing support during peak operational periods, including occasional evening or weekend work.
  • Offering guidance and knowledge transfer to FIFA departments and related entities on immigration procedures.
  • Providing visa support for FIFA staff business travel when necessary.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Completion of a related University degree or diploma.
  • 3–5 years of experience in visa and immigration operations or a similar role.
  • Experience working with external vendors or service providers.
  • Strong IT skills, including MS Office proficiency.
  • Additional certification in business administration is an asset.
  • Experience in international or cross‑cultural work environments preferred.
  • Problem solving and conflict resolution skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and sound judgment, with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively and diplomatically with all counterparts, achieving high quality results in difficult and challenging circumstances.
  • Ability to embrace change and be highly adaptable to new challenges and opportunities.
  • Experience working in multicultural, multi‑disciplinary teams, ideally with immigration professionals.
  • Project and event management experience is considered an advantage.
  • Practical knowledge of global mobility or international administrative processes is beneficial.

Requirements

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Buscamos um profissional dinâmico e estratégico para gerenciar e desenvolver uma carteira de parceiros, com foco especial no desenvolvimento e aceleração de performance de novos parceiros de vendas de Energia Compartilhada através da Geração Distribuída .   • Conhecimento aprofundado do mercado de GD (Geração Distribuída) é fundamental para essa posição.
  • Domínio de CRM (Customer Relationship Management) e outras ferramentas de vendas.
  • Habilidade de negociação e excelente comunicação interpessoal .

title: Gerente Regional RJ
description:
Grupo Ultra A Ultra já nasceu acreditando que o esporte e a atividade física são capazes de transformar nós mesmos, o outro e a sociedade.

Todos nós temos o poder de fazer a diferença. E se o mundo está tão diferente por que as academias são todas iguais? Chegamos para fazer diferente.

Propósito

Existimos para ser uma ferramenta poderosa de transformação através de atividades física e esportes. Nascemos como um agente incansável de mudanças, incentivando, motivando e oferecendo a estrutura e serviços adequados para a prática de exercícios.

Objetivos Da Função

Garantir a excelência operacional e de performance das unidades sob sua responsabilidade, assegurando o cumprimento dos padrões da Master Franquia RJ- SP01, o alcance das metas e o desenvolvimento contínuo das equipes e líderes de cada unidade. O Gerente Regional é o principal elo entre a diretoria e as operações locais, responsável por traduzir a estratégia da empresa em resultados consistentes e sustentáveis.

Responsabilidades Da Função

  • Supervisionar as operações de todas as unidades sob sua responsabilidade, assegurando que os padrões de qualidade, atendimento e processos sejam seguidos.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho (vendas, retenção, NPS, controle de despesas, produtividade e resultados financeiros).
  • Acompanhar e garantir a execução dos planos de ação, metas e estratégias definidas pela diretoria.
  • Realizar visitas de campo periódicas às unidades, observando a operação, atendimento, manutenção e clima organizacional.
  • Garantir que todas as áreas (técnica, coletivas, comercial e administrativa) operem de forma integrada e eficiente.
  • Realizar visita de campo semanal, no mínimo 5 unidades por semana ou decidir com a diretoria calendário semanal.
  • Garantir que limpeza e manutenção estejam 100% nas unidades.
  • Garantir que todos os prestadores de serviços externos estejam 100% alinhados aos contratos, minutas e cláusulas vigentes, devidamente revisados e assinados pela Diretoria antes do início das atividades.
  • Assegurar a conformidade contratual e operacional dos parceiros, realizando acompanhamento periódico e feedback estruturado sobre performance e entregas.
  • Acompanhar e garantir o cumprimento dos indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) das unidades, assegurando resultados consistentes em Safra, NPS, Treinos, Ativos, Churn, Avaliação de Plano e Retenção de Alunos.
  • Realizar a entrega mensal do plano de ação baseado nos KPI Financeiros, Operacionais e de Equipe, com metas, prazos e responsáveis definidos.
  • Realizar análise de resultados e elaborar planos corretivos e preventivos junto aos gestores das unidades.
  • Garantir que todas as unidades estejam operando dentro do Headcount (HC) estipulado pelo RH, mantendo equilíbrio entre produtividade e controle de custos.
  • Acompanhar a execução dos processos e padrões definidos pela franqueadora, assegurando o alinhamento de toda a operação regional.

Competências e Requisitos

  • Formação: Ensino Superior completo (preferencialmente em Administração, Educação Física, Gestão de Negócios ou áreas correlatas). Pós-graduação é um diferencial.
  • Experiência: Vivência sólida em gestão de múltiplas unidades (academias, varejo ou franquias).
  • Conhecimentos técnicos:
    • Gestão de indicadores de performance (KPIs);
    • Análise financeira e controle de custos;
    • Gestão de pessoas e desenvolvimento de líderes;
    • Padronização e controle operacional;
    • Planejamento estratégico e execução tática.
  • Habilidades comportamentais:

title: Senior IT Engineer – Global Offices Network
description:
About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America — and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank.
Learn more about our career opportunities here.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior IT Engineer to design, implement, and operate our global office and data center network . In this role, you will own the connectivity and performance of Nu’s physical locations, ensuring that our offices and data centers are reliable, secure, and ready to support our next waves of growth.

You will work on routing, switching, wireless, security, and observability across our global stack, leading key initiatives such as new office rollouts, critical connectivity improvements, and the evolution towards Infrastructure as Code (IaC) . You will be part of the Global Offices Network team, working closely with peers in Connectivity, Security, and Workplace to provide a seamless experience for Nubankers worldwide.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Network & Connectivity

  • Design, implement, and support enterprise network infrastructure for offices and data centers, including routing, switching, and wireless.
  • Maintain and evolve high‑availability data center fabrics (e.g., spine‑and‑leaf topologies with Juniper/Cisco hardware).
  • Ensure robust connectivity between offices and data centers , including WAN and SD‑WAN solutions, focusing on performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Configure and support wireless networks (controllers and access points), with strong experience in vendors such as Aruba and Cisco.
  • Operate and tune load balancers (e.g., F5 , including DNS/ZoneRunner concepts) to guarantee optimal application delivery and resilience.
  • Collaborate with security teams on Next‑Generation Firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet) and cloud security brokers (e.g., Zscaler) in a “security‑first” network design.

Automation, IaC & Observability

  • Drive the transition away from manual configuration towards Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as GitHub, Terraform, and/or Ansible .
  • Implement and maintain network performance monitoring and observability using tools like PRTG, Prometheus, Grafana, SolarWinds or similar , ensuring proactive detection and resolution of incidents.
  • Manage PKI-related activities , including SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle and ensuring secure encrypted communications across services and endpoints.

Delivery & Collaboration

  • Lead or co‑lead new office implementations and major network changes, coordinating with Workplace, Connectivity, and other partner teams.
  • Act as a technical reference for incident response and problem management in critical networking issues, helping restore services quickly and preventing recurrences.
  • Document architectures, runbooks, and standards, helping scale knowledge across the team.
  • Mentor more junior engineers and collaborate in a multi‑level team (IC6, IC5, IC3, IC4) to continuously improve how we operate our global infrastructure.

We Are Looking for a Person Who Has

  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise networking or infrastructure engineering , working with critical environments (e.g., large offices, data centers, or mission‑critical operations).
  • Strong hands‑on experience with routing and switching , ideally using vendors such as Cisco and/or Juniper.
  • Experience implementing and supporting wireless networks , especially with Aruba and/or Cisco wireless solutions.
  • Solid experience operating network monitoring and performance tools (e.g., PRTG, SolarWinds, Prometheus, Grafana or similar) in production environments.
  • Experience with load balancers (e.g., F5 ) and DNS‑related components (e.g., ZoneRunner or equivalent).
  • Exposure to network security components , such as enterprise firewalls and/or security brokers, and comfort collaborating with security teams in a “security‑first” posture.
  • Experience with or strong interest in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation for network configuration and lifecycle management (e.g., GitHub, Terraform, Ansible ).
  • Ability to lead initiatives and coordinate teams during new office rollouts, complex changes, and incident response.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills, ownership mindset, and ability to work in cross‑functional, multicultural teams .
  • Intermediate English (spoken and written), with the ability to participate in meetings and collaborate with global teams.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Zero Trust network concepts and security‑driven networking.
  • Experience with cloud networking (e.g., connectivity to public clouds) and hybrid environments.
  • Experience with security mindset and encryption topics (e.g., secure protocols, network segmentation), even if not your primary specialization.
  • Prior experience in distributed or global organizations .

Location

This opportunity is based in Brazil , with a strong preference for candidates who can work from our offices in:

You will be part of the Brazil Global Offices Network team and collaborate with colleagues in other locations as needed.

For employees based in Brazil , we offer:

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank
  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)
  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program
  • Life Insurance
  • Medical Plan
  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program
  • Nucleo – Our learning platform of courses
  • Extended Parental Leave
  • Daycare Allowance
  • Parental Consultancy
  • Work-from-home Allowance
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Relocation Assistance Package , if applicable

Work Model for This Role

This role follows our hybrid work model . Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least 2–3 times per week , on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit our article about Nu’s hybrid work model.

Sobre o CNA Idiomas

O CNA Idiomas é uma rede de ensino de inglês e espanhol com uma trajetória de mais de 50 anos no mercado, e é parte do grupo educacional CNA+, atendendo cerca de 400 mil alunos anualmente em mais de 730 unidades em todo o território brasileiro. Em um universo com mais de 3 mil marcas, o CNA Idiomas é a única rede a obter, por 32 vezes consecutivas, o Selo de Excelência, concedido pela Associação Brasileira de Franchising (ABF), que em 2020 também escolheu o CNA Idiomas como Franqueador do Ano. A Ctrl+Play é uma rede de franquias de tecnologia e inovação que oferece cursos de robótica e programação para o público a partir de 7 anos. Com metodologias de ensino exclusivas e recursos tecnológicos avançados, os alunos podem desenvolver habilidades em programação, robótica, criação de jogos, modelagem 3D e aprender conceitos de lógica de forma dinâmica, divertida e envolvente, proporciona uma experiência de aprendizado estimulante e enriquecedora. A escola faz parte do grupo CNA+ desde novembro de 2023 e, atualmente, conta com mais de 90 unidades em operação. A Ctrl+Play também é uma das marcas franqueadoras integrantes da Associação Brasileira do Franchising (ABF).

Grupo educacional com mais de 900 franquias localizadas em todos os estados do Brasil, o CNA+ é composto pelas marcas CNA Idiomas e Ctrl+Play. A franquia de ensino de idiomas (cursos de inglês e espanhol) tem mais de 50 anos de atuação no mercado e cerca de 400 mil alunos/ano em mais de 730 unidades, sendo uma das marcas mais premiadas do franchising nacional. Já a Ctrl+Play, franquia de tecnologia e inovação, oferece cursos de robótica e programação para o público a partir de 7 anos.   • Garantir alinhamentos técnicos operacionais, participando das reuniões de revisão técnica com o cliente.
  • Preparar e realizar as reuniões de Kick-Off, garantindo o panorama adequado dos projetos, aderência à estratégia de HSE, informações sobre a unidade, instalações de planejamento, riscos já mapeados, oportunidades e lições aprendidas com outros projetos da unidade e frota.
  • Garantir que os Projetos de Turnaround da frota da MODEC sejam planejados e executados de forma otimizada e integrada (Atividades SPIE, Medição, Projeto, Operação, Cliente Externo etc.), através do desenvolvimento de Cronogramas-Mestre de projetos e Cronogramas de Execução de Projetos, definindo o histograma de projetos e definindo/congelando escopos de projetos.
  • Liderar a coordenação das atividades offshore durante a fase de execução por meio do monitoramento e relatório do andamento do projeto, acompanhando o cumprimento de prazos, custos e qualidade das entregas, e fornecendo suporte aos coordenadores de projetos com resposta oportuna em caso de anomalias identificadas ou eventos inesperados, além de fornecer suporte corporativo sempre que necessário.
  • Colaborar para o desenvolvimento das Lições Aprendidas, preparando, emitindo e apresentando relatórios de close-out, com todas as informações relevantes e conhecimento adquirido dos projetos para identificar oportunidades de melhoria para desenvolvimento futuro e compartilhamento de conhecimento ao longo da frota, e fechando todas as Work Orders do turnaround no CMMS.
  • Garantir o backload e o retorno de todos os equipamentos, ferramentas e materiais pertencentes a empreiteiros e fornecedores, acompanhando adequadamente todos os casos.
  • Executar os processos de Avaliação de Riscos e Gestão de Riscos dos projetos, realizando brainstorms de Avaliação de Riscos com os stakeholders necessários, compilando e analisando todos os riscos levantados, emitindo o Registro de Risco, identificando possíveis ações de Plano de Resposta e monitorando o andamento dessas ações.
  • Garantir que todos os sistemas/equipamentos sejam restabelecidos ao desempenho regular após a conclusão do projeto e devidamente entregues à operação.
  • Estabelecer uma integração com stakeholders internos e externos (outras áreas da empresa, clientes, fornecedores etc.) e/ou clientes externos, preparando e realizando reuniões periódicas para alinhar o planejamento, detalhes e requisitos das atividades do projeto e apresentar o andamento do projeto.
  • Interagir com o Departamento de Compras para desenvolver um Plano de Compras com base nos recursos necessários para que cada trabalho seja realizado (materiais, serviços e equipamentos), controlando POs e acompanhando com o departamento o status dos materiais/serviços solicitados e a devolução das ferramentas e equipamentos do fornecedor.

title: Auxiliar de Almoxarifado
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará), Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

description:
About Us

Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow and inefficient financial system. Since then, through innovative technology and outstanding customer service, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America. With operations in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, Nubank is today one of the largest digital banking platforms and technology-leading companies in the world. Nubank was listed on the NYSE in 2021 and was recently named one of Time Magazine's 100 Most Influential Companies. For more information, visit

About the Role

At Nubank, our Credit Card platform is the core of our global expansion. We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join our platform team as a technical anchor, ensuring our systems remain scalable and flexible as we maintain sustainable growth and innovation in the countries where we currently operate, while also launching into new international markets. You will play a vital role in evolving the architecture of one of our most complex and strategic products.

You will operate within a high-impact triad alongside Product and Management, focusing on long-term technical strategy and system health. As a hands-on technical leader, you will challenge the status quo, propose innovation and solve deep architectural problems, mentor and become a technical reference for our engineering team. Your work will directly enable millions of customers to access financial products via credit card worldwide.

Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the long-term vision and strategy for the global architecture of the core credit card platform, ensuring exponential scalability and continuous evolution capability.
  • Lead the strategic partnership with Product and Business leadership (C-level and VPs) to shape the medium and long-term technical roadmap and define the strategic OKRs and global impact KPIs.
  • Act as a technical and cultural reference, defining the highest standards of engineering excellence, mentoring other Architects and Principal/Staff Engineers, and fostering a culture of innovation and accountability.
  • Lead and resolve the most ambitious and high-risk technical challenges, intervening in critical performance or resilience bottlenecks and driving technical execution for solutions with multi-system and multi-country impact.
  • Design and oversee the execution of complex system transformations (e.g., core banking migrations, replacement of legacy platforms) ensuring regulatory compliance in multiple jurisdictions and fiscal regimes, proactively mitigating risks.
  • Communicate and defend the technical strategy eloquently and convincingly to the executive board and non-technical audiences, translating architecture decisions into business value and competitive advantage.

Required Qualifications

  • Principal/Staff Engineer level experience or equivalent with an extensive and demonstrable history in architecting and scaling mission-critical, high-volume, and low-latency systems in global fintech or e-commerce environments.
  • Expert proficiency (demonstrated in code and design) in multiple programming paradigms, with significant hands-on experience in functional programming (e.g., Clojure, Scala, Haskell) and reactive/event-based architectures.
  • Proven ability to establish and lead the long-term technical strategy for entire platform ecosystems (not just isolated components), influencing the direction of multiple engineering groups.
  • Deep and successful experience in navigating and defining the architecture in highly regulated financial environments (e.g., BACEN, FCA, SOX) and designing systems to meet data residency requirements and complex cross-border transactions.
  • History of successfully leading and completing large-scale platform transformations (e.g., transition from monoliths to microservices mesh, migration of data centers or clouds), managing risks and operational impact.
  • In-depth knowledge of credit card/payment systems design is a significant differential.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Clojure or similar functional languages.
  • Proven interest or experience in leveraging AI to optimize engineering workflows.
  • Deep domain knowledge of credit card processing or financial ledgers.

Location & Work Model

This role is based on a hybrid model at one of our Nubank offices in Brazil (São Paulo, Campinas, Rio de Janeiro, or Belo Horizonte), the United States (Palo Alto, Durham, Washington D.C. or Miami), or Canada (Toronto) .

At Nubank, we believe that diversity is essential to building the best products and services. We are committed to creating a welcoming work environment that respects and values diversity in all its forms, and we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

A Clubbi é um marketplace B2B para pequenos mercados de bairro. Fornecemos uma nova forma de abastecer a loja: mais conveniente, aos melhores preços e com os melhores prazos de entrega.

Nossa visão é otimizar toda a cadeia de suprimentos e operações para este segmento do varejo, que representa um mercado de R$250Bi somente no Brasil.

A Clubbi foi fundada em 2020 e já chamou atenção de alguns dos melhores fundos de VC do Brasil e do Vale do Silício: Valor Capital, OneVC, Canary, Better Tomorrow Ventures.

Em 2022, recebemos a rodada Series A, liderada por Hi Ventures e Nfx.

Nossa Cultura e Valores

Nossa missão é fortalecer os pequenos varejistas como os maiores protagonistas do comércio na América Latina.

A gente acredita que por meio da digitalização de toda a cadeia de suprimentos e das operações do varejo podemos nos transformar no canal mais eficiente de distribuição para estes produtos.

Para ter sucesso neste objetivo, desenvolvemos uma cultura única e especial:

  • Nos desprendemos da nossa realidade para vestir a camisa pelo nosso cliente;
  • Desenvolvemos um time fora da curva;
  • Não temos medo de errar, desde que isso nos ensine alguma coisa;
  • Temos foco e somos obcecados por priorização e eficiência;
  • Tratamos adultos como adultos, com autonomia e responsabilidade;
  • Somos transparentes e não-hierárquicos;
  • Nos preocupamos genuinamente com as nossas pessoas;
  • Cuidamos para que a Clubbi seja um local incrível para trabalhar.
  • Acreditamos que um ambiente de excelência, aprendizado rápido, foco obsessivo no cliente junto com muita colaboração e diversão permite a todos alcançar o seu potencial pleno e contribuir com nossa missão.

Missão do Cargo

Num contexto de forte crescimento das vendas, gerenciar nossa frota agregada, assegurando profissionalismo, eficiência e disponibilidade dos motoristas.

A área de transporte tem um papel essencial dentro da Clubbi, impactando a experiência dos nossos clientes no momento da entrega, e garantindo nosso crescimento por meio da captação e desenvolvimento de novos motoristas.

A área de transporte também é responsável pelo transporte first mile, dos nossos fornecedores até o nosso armazém.

Com um amplo portfólio de medicamentos, suplementos e cosméticos, atuamos em dois segmentos: Medicamentos de prescrição (RX) e Autocuidado (OTC).

Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department and Location

Department: Finance

Location: Brazil

Position

Under the responsibility of the FIFA27 Head of Finance and in collaboration with the FIFA Finance division in Zurich, the Senior Event Controller will drive in Brazil the budget and forecast process throughout the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ project lifecycle providing finance business partnering and support to the various budget owners and to FIFA27 senior management.

Responsibilities

  • Assist with the preparation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™budget, for the period , which captures all the operational costs to ensure the successful delivery of the tournament.
  • Assist with the implementation of the FIFA budgeting and reporting tools and organize hands-on training with the budget owners in Brazil.
  • Prepare cash flow forecast requirements in connection with the Brazilian operational budget.
  • Lead in Brazil the financial planning and budget review processes working closely with the FIFA Senior Event Controller (based in Zurich) and with all budget owners (Zurich and Brazil based).
  • Work closely with the FIFA Senior Event Controller, to implement FIFA Finance processes in Brazil and to support a smooth consolidation of the full tournament operational budgets.
  • Present the outcome of the quarterly forecast exercise as well as recommended corrective actions (when necessary) to the various stakeholders.
  • Coordinate the accrual process at year-end supporting the FIFA Zurich and FIFA27 Accounting teams and the various budget owners.
  • Review monthly cost allocations to various project codes and prepare re-allocation journals when required.
  • Prepare monthly management reports providing insightful commentary for budget owners and senior management.
  • Monitor and maintain monthly cash flow forecasts, reflecting the Brazilian operational budget, to ensure the liquidity needs of FIFA27 are met.
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis and prepare additional financial reports as requested by the Head of Finance and senior management.

Your profile / Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in accounting and Financial Planning & Analysis.
  • Experience in an event organization in a financial role (organizing major sport events or other similar projects).
  • Advanced knowledge and experience with budgeting and reporting tools.
  • Experience in preparing financial statements, preferably in a multi-entity environment.
  • Experience in an international environment.
  • Experience in procurement of advantage.
  • SAP experience preferred.
  • Well-developed organisational skills with an ability to prioritize your workload and meet strict deadlines.
  • Business fluent in English, any other language is an asset.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills to facilitate business partnering.
  • Have a proactive hands-on approach to problem solving - a 'can do' attitude.
  • Strong attention to detail and a focus on quality and accuracy.
  • Well-versed in Microsoft Office Excel, Word & Powerpoint presentation.
  • Ability to work independently and with a team in a fast-paced and high-volume environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Mecânico de Manutenção (Refrigeração e Climatização) - Unidade Madureira
description:
Overview

Descrição da vaga

Profissional que irá efetuar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva, conforme PMOC (Plano de Manutenção, Operação e Controle do sistema de ar condicionado), atendimentos emergenciais, atuando com reparo e manuseio de equipamentos e sistemas de ar condicionado, incluindo bombas hidráulicas, substituindo peças e efetuando testes funcionais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Faz a manutenção preventiva e corretiva de instalações e equipamentos de refrigeração, ventilação, calefação e ar-condicionado. Realiza teste, lubrificação e regulagem nos sistemas de refrigeração e climatização.
  • O Mecânico de Refrigeração é o profissional responsável por montar, instalar e pôr em funcionamento equipamentos de refrigeração e ar condicionado residencial e comercial, realizando análises, ajustes de performance, detectando e corrigindo falhas de origem elétrica e mecânica, de acordo com desenhos técnicos, projetos e normas técnicas, em condições de qualidade, segurança e preservação ambiental.
  • Efetuar a operação, manutenção preventiva e corretiva, conforme PMOC (Plano de Manutenção, Operação e Controle do sistema de ar condicionado), atendimentos emergenciais, atuando com reparo e manuseio de equipamentos e sistemas de ar condicionado, incluindo bombas hidráulicas, substituindo peças e efetuando testes funcionais.
  • Executar rondas e rotinas diárias de serviços tais como: ligar e desligar equipamentos;
  • Efetuar inspeções e verificar condições de operação dos equipamentos e sistemas, casas de máquinas; verificar níveis de ruído dos equipamentos;
  • Efetuar leitura e medições nos equipamentos;
  • Efetuar medições das condições ambientais;
  • Efetuar regulagens necessárias nos equipamentos e sistemas;
  • Verificar níveis de reservatórios em geral; Verificar possíveis vazamentos e entupimentos em geral;
  • Atender chamados de reclamações pertinentes;
  • Verificar existência de irregularidades nos ambientes condicionados; visualizar sistemas de supervisão e possíveis alarmes;
  • Detectar eventuais deficiências dos sistemas e equipamentos, atuando na prevenção de falhas, minimizando defeitos e possíveis impactos;
  • Efetuar manutenções conforme as recomendações dos fabricantes e check list de atividades de manutenção;
  • Gerenciar e acompanhar os serviços contratados de empresas especializadas em Tratamento de Água, Análise de Qualidade do Ar e Manutenção de Resfriadores de Líquido e Condicionadores de Ar Especiais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ter no mínimo 18 anos de idade;
  • Ter no mínimo o Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Boa comunicação;
  • Necessário ter no mínimo 6 meses de experiência de campo com refrigeração (ar condicionado) - Técnico de refrigeração em ar condicionado;
  • Necessário Formação Técnica em Refrigeração/Climatização e/ou Elétrica;
  • Preferencialmente morar próximo à Unidade Atento Madureira.

Informações adicionais

  • Salário : R$ 2.100,00
  • Horário de Trabalho : Das 21h00 às 06:48
  • Jornada de Trabalho : 220h mês | 5X2 - Folga sábados e domingos
  • Benefícios : Vale Transporte; Vale refeição e/ou vale alimentação; Seguro de Vida; Auxílio funeral; Auxílio creche / Auxílio criança com deficiência / Auxílio babá / Auxílio transporte escolar; Desconto em Produtos; Assistência Odontológica; Assistência Médica; Plano Pet; Descontos em Academias / Práticas Esportivas; Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos; Plano de carreira.
  • Local de Trabalho : R. João Vicente, 187 - Madureira, Rio de Janeiro - RJ, , Rio de Janeiro.

Muito prazer, somos a Atento!

Impulsionados por IA. Conectados por pessoas. A Atento é referência no setor de BPO há muitos anos. Agora, estamos dando um passo além, liderando o movimento de Business Transformation Outsourcing (BTO), uma nova forma de transformar a experiência do cliente. Fazemos isso unindo consultoria, inteligência artificial, valorização das pessoas e excelência operacional. Nossa força está em nossas pessoas. Especialistas apaixonados, capazes de tornar a tecnologia algo simples, eficaz e com impacto real.

Se você se identifica com esse propósito, valoriza a empatia e acredita que a tecnologia deve servir às pessoas, vem com a gente!

Aqui, você fará parte de experiências que transformam, gerando conexão e resultados reais.

Conheça também os nossos outros Portais de Carreiras: Portal Atento – para vagas de atendimento ao cliente (chat, voz, e-mail, etc); Portal Atento Digital - para quem quer atuar com marketing digital e redes sociais; Portal Atento TI – voltado para talentos da tecnologia; Atento PAP – para quem quer atuar como vendedor/supervisor externo (Porta a Porta); Interfile – com vagas voltadas para soluções de backoffice e gestão de processos; Portal PcD – com vagas exclusivas para pessoas com deficiência.

Dica: mantenha seus dados sempre atualizados e completos, e procure concluir um processo antes de iniciar outro, combinado?

Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo. A Aegea

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Descrição da vaga

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

Inclusão e Diversidade

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

title: Lead Security Engineer (GRC)
description:
Overview

About Nubank: Nubank was founded in 2013 with the mission of fighting complexity to empower people in their daily lives by reinventing financial services. Today, we are one of the largest digital banking platforms in the world, serving millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. For more information, visit our careers page:

About The Team

The Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team enables Nubank to remain compliant with legal, regulatory, and internal requirements, while continuously identifying, classifying, and monitoring risks and providing strategic insights and performance evaluation to leadership. The GRC squad collaborates with multidisciplinary teams to align our technology security strategy with Nubank’s overall business objectives, ensuring that identified risks are mitigated and that risk-based decision-making is enabled within and beyond the IT & Security Business Unit.

About The Role

You will be responsible for acting as a technical reference in security, certifications, and internal controls, serving as a bridge between engineering, risk, audit, and business stakeholders. You will define strategies, support risk-based decision-making, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are effectively embedded into processes, systems, and products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a senior technical and governance reference across security, certifications, risk, and internal controls, influencing strategy.
  • Identify control gaps and improvement opportunities in technical procedures required for certification and recertification processes (e.g., ISO 27001, PCI-DSS).
  • Develop and maintain strong partnerships with business and technical leaders to orchestrate audits, assessments, and remediation plans in a risk-based and scalable way.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to define action plans that ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies.
  • Conduct assessments of internal controls, ensuring adherence to internal policies, legal requirements, and industry standards.
  • Identify gaps and improvement opportunities in the internal controls landscape and lead control reviews, ensuring timely resolution of issues.
  • Work closely with Risk teams to align on the mitigation of identified risks.
  • Support responses to audit requests, regulatory inquiries, and due diligence from business partners.
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, IT, and global teams to integrate compliance and security requirements into processes and systems.
  • Define and monitor KRIs and KPIs, delivering forward-looking, data-driven insights to senior management and Committees.
  • Drive continuous improvement and scale, simplifying processes and strengthening Nubank’s Security Maturity as the company grows globally.

Qualification Requirements

  • Solid experience in information security, with strong knowledge of frameworks such as PCI-DSS, ISO 27000 family, NIST, and similar.
  • Prior experience with security certification processes and/or internal controls, compliance, and audit support.
  • Excellent executive communication skills, capable of translating complex topics into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership and committees.
  • Experience operating in regulated and global environments, including interaction with auditors and regulators.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Security Information, Risk Management or related fields.
  • Familiarity with using AI and automation (e.g., machine learning, generative AI, or LLM-based tooling) to enhance security compliance use cases.
  • Knowledge of the regulatory landscape relevant to financial services, such as SOx, BACEN, CVM, CNBV, ANBIMA, SEC, and related regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP) and implementing security controls in these contexts.
  • Advanced English (written and verbal) required.

Nice To Have Requirements

  • Relevant certifications such as CRISC, CISA, Security+, CISSP, or CISM are considered a strong plus.

International experience is highly desirable.

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

title: Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead one of our teams that work closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google and other world‑class cloud partners to optimize Ubuntu for their infrastructure. Our team builds, tests, and publishes the base Ubuntu images used by millions to ensure optimal performance and security in their cloud estate. We aim to deliver the very best public cloud VM experience, as well as specialized images for specific purposes on each cloud. Our goal is to celebrate and enable their particular points of differentiation on their clouds, while also ensure a common operating experience for their users.

As an engineering manager you need to bring both technical and management skills to the leadership of your team. You will also need to represent the team in direct partner engagement. You'll be responsible for the stability and functionality that our cloud users have come to expect. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu image products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU‑aided AI for servers, VM’s and containers.

As an engineering manager at Canonical your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, doing valuable work, and generally having a great time at Canonical. As a lead for strong engineers, technical leadership and a solid background in software development is a must, so that you're able to challenge and grow your team members. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team is building with. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high performing team.

Role entails

  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your and similar timezones
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands‑on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel up to 15% for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with at least one of Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Senior IT Engineer – Global Offices Network
description:
Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America — and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Learn more about our career opportunities here.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior IT Engineer to design, implement, and operate our global office and data center network . In this role, you will own the connectivity and performance of Nu’s physical locations, ensuring that our offices and data centers are reliable, secure, and ready to support our next waves of growth. You will work on routing, switching, wireless, security, and observability across our global stack, leading key initiatives such as new office rollouts, critical connectivity improvements, and the evolution towards Infrastructure as Code (IaC) . You will be part of the Global Offices Network team, working closely with peers in Connectivity, Security, and Workplace to provide a seamless experience for Nubankers worldwide.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Network & Connectivity

  • Design, implement, and support enterprise network infrastructure for offices and data centers, including routing, switching, and wireless.
  • Maintain and evolve high-availability data center fabrics (e.g., spine-and-leaf topologies with Juniper/Cisco hardware).
  • Ensure robust connectivity between offices and data centers, including WAN and SD-WAN solutions, focusing on performance, reliability, and scalability.

Wireless, Load Balancing & Security

  • Configure and support wireless networks (controllers and access points), with strong experience in vendors such as Aruba and Cisco.
  • Operate and tune load balancers (e.g., F5, including DNS/ZoneRunner concepts) to guarantee optimal application delivery and resilience.
  • Collaborate with security teams on Next-Generation Firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet) and cloud security brokers (e.g., Zscaler) in a “security-first” network design.

Automation, IaC & Observability

  • Drive the transition away from manual configuration towards Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as GitHub, Terraform, and/or Ansible.
  • Implement and maintain network performance monitoring and observability using tools like PRTG, Prometheus, Grafana, SolarWinds or similar, ensuring proactive detection and resolution of incidents.
  • Manage PKI-related activities, including SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle and ensuring secure encrypted communications across services and endpoints.

Delivery & Collaboration

  • Lead or co-lead new office implementations and major network changes, coordinating with Workplace, Connectivity, and other partner teams.
  • Act as a technical reference for incident response and problem management in critical networking issues, helping restore services quickly and preventing recurrences.
  • Document architectures, runbooks, and standards, helping scale knowledge across the team.
  • Mentor more junior engineers and collaborate in a multi-level team (IC6, IC5, IC3, IC4) to continuously improve how we operate our global infrastructure.

We Are Looking for a Person Who Has

  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise networking or infrastructure engineering, working with critical environments (e.g., large offices, data centers, or mission-critical operations).
  • Strong hands-on experience with routing and switching, ideally using vendors such as Cisco and/or Juniper.
  • Experience implementing and supporting wireless networks, especially with Aruba and/or Cisco wireless solutions.
  • Solid experience operating network monitoring and performance tools (e.g., PRTG, SolarWinds, Prometheus, Grafana or similar) in production environments.
  • Experience with load balancers (e.g., F5) and DNS-related components (e.g., ZoneRunner or equivalent).
  • Exposure to network security components, such as enterprise firewalls and/or security brokers, and comfort collaborating with security teams in a “security-first” posture.
  • Experience with or strong interest in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation for network configuration and lifecycle management (e.g., GitHub, Terraform, Ansible).
  • Ability to lead initiatives and coordinate teams during new office rollouts, complex changes, and incident response.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, ownership mindset, and ability to work in cross-functional, multicultural teams.
  • Intermediate English (spoken and written), with the ability to participate in meetings and collaborate with global teams.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Zero Trust network concepts and security-driven networking.
  • Experience with cloud networking (e.g., connectivity to public clouds) and hybrid environments.
  • Experience with security mindset and encryption topics (e.g., secure protocols, network segmentation), even if not your primary specialization.
  • Prior experience in distributed or global organizations.

Location

This opportunity is based in Brazil , with a strong preference for candidates who can work from our offices in:

  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Belo Horizonte, Brazil

You will be part of the Brazil Global Offices Network team and collaborate with colleagues in other locations as needed.

Our Benefits – Brazil

For Employees Based In Brazil, We Offer

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank
  • Food/Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale-Alimentação)
  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)
  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program
  • Life Insurance
  • Medical Plan
  • Dental Plan
  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program
  • Nucleo – Our learning platform of courses
  • Extended Parental Leave
  • Daycare Allowance
  • Parental Consultancy
  • Work-from-home Allowance
  • Gym Partnerships
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model for This Role

This role follows our hybrid work model . Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least 2–3 times per week , on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit our article about Nu’s hybrid work model.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
  • Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.
  • Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Divulgar e promover os produtos da empresa, mediante visitas periódicas às empresas de projeto e clientes como Construtoras, Escritórios de Arquitetura, Instaladores e Projetistas. Garantir a conversão técnica de projetos em especificação de produtos e, posteriormente, em vendas.

title: Lead IT Engineer - Service Management
description:
About Us


Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America — and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Learn more at


About the Team


The IT team is the operational backbone of Nubank’s internal infrastructure. As the company scales, we’re building the service management foundations that let engineering teams move faster with more confidence — turning IT operations into a strategic advantage, not just a support function.


About the Role


As a Lead IT Engineer - Service Management, you will own and evolve Nubank’s IT Service Management (ITSM) practice end to end. You’ll design and implement processes, tools, and governance that keep our internal services reliable, auditable, and efficient, enabling engineering teams to focus on high‑impact work while maintaining strong operational controls in a regulated environment.


You’ll Be Responsible For



  • Continuing to build and own Nubank's ITSM practice, defining and implementing core ITIL v4 processes: incident, problem, change, service request, and knowledge management.

  • Establishing a service catalog with clearly defined SLAs and OLAs aligned with internal stakeholder expectations.

  • Owning the end‑to‑end ITSM toolchain (Jira Service Management or equivalent): configuration, workflow design, form logic, SLA rules, and integrations with adjacent systems.

  • Identifying and closing automation gaps — routing, escalation, notifications, and reporting — partnering with engineering teams to reduce manual toil across operations.

  • Defining and tracking operational KPIs (MTTR, SLA compliance, first‑contact resolution, change success rate) and building regular reporting cadences for leadership and stakeholders.

  • Establishing a Change Advisory Board (CAB) with structured documentation and approval workflows.

  • Supporting audit and compliance requirements with structured evidence of IT operational controls, essential for a regulated financial environment.

  • Driving ITSM adoption across the organization, creating runbooks, training materials, and documentation that embed service management culture at scale.


Mandatory qualifications



  • 7+ years of experience in IT service management, IT operations, or a related discipline.

  • Deep ITIL v4 expertise; ITIL 4 Foundation or Managing Professional certification strongly preferred.

  • Proven track record of building ITSM practices from scratch or significantly transforming an existing function.

  • Hands‑on experience owning and configuring ITSM tooling end‑to‑end (Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or equivalent) — not just using it, but designing it.

  • Ability to work cross‑functionally in a fast‑paced, engineering‑led environment, with strong influence‑without‑authority skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to present to senior leadership.


Nice‑to‑have qualifications



  • Experience in fintech, high‑growth tech, or other regulated industries.

  • Familiarity with adjacent frameworks: COBIT, ISO 20000, or SRE principles.

  • Experience partnering with Security and/or Platform Engineering teams.


What We Offer



  • Greenfield, high‑visibility scope: you’ll define what “good” ITSM looks like at Nubank’s scale — from zero.

  • Direct exposure to senior leadership across IT and Engineering.

  • A culture that values ownership and getting foundations right, without bureaucracy for its own sake.

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank.

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale‑Transporte).

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program.

  • Life Insurance.

  • Medical Plan.

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program.

  • Nucleo – Our learning platform of courses.

  • Extended Parental Leave.

  • Daycare Allowance.

  • Parental Consultancy.

  • Work‑from‑home Allowance.

  • 30 days of paid vacation.

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.


(For hybrid roles, commuting‑related benefits such as Vale‑Transporte and gym partnerships remain applicable.)


Work Model for This Role


Hybrid – 2–3 times per week in the office.


Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit


Exploring Nubank


Explore how we build technology at Nubank:


At Nubank, we want to be sure that we’re building a more diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the customers we serve and seek to empower. That’s why we hire based on equality. We consider gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexual orientation, and other identity markers as enriching elements to our company, while ensuring none of them represent a barrier when recruiting fantastic talent.


How to Apply


If you’re excited about building a robust IT Service Management foundation that enables Nubank to scale with reliability and speed, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and help us shape the future of financial services in Latin America.

description:
A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores

  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Integridade Sênior (Inspeção) que será responsável pela gestão da integridade e inspeção de dutos e equipamentos, incluindo identificação, mensuração e proposição de mitigação, garantindo a segurança operacional, a confiabilidade do sistema de transporte e o atendimento às regulamentações vigentes, com foco em Proteção Catódica e desejável conhecimento em NR‑13/SPIE.

Responsabilidades

  • Proteção Catódica: gerenciar e acompanhar sistemas de proteção catódica de dutos, incluindo monitoramento de potenciais, desempenho de retificadores, interferências eletromagnéticas e condições de corrosão externa. Analisar resultados de levantamentos de campo (CIPS, DCVG, PCM/A-Frame, entre outros) e propor ações corretivas e preventivas.

  • Avaliação de Defeitos: Realizar análises de defeitos com base em normas técnicas (API 579, ASME B31.G, B31.8, entre outras).
  • Gestão de Indicadores: Atualizar e acompanhar KPIs da área, elaborando relatórios técnicos e de suporte ao gestor.
  • Gestão do Conhecimento: Orientar técnicos, promover boas práticas de inspeção e fortalecer a cultura de integridade.
  • Gestão de Contratos: Selecionar, contratar e acompanhar serviços de inspeção e integridade em campo.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia.
  • Experiência em proteção catódica, integridade de dutos e desejável NR‑13.
  • Domínio: Proteção Catódica, Pacote Office.
  • Conhecimento: NR‑13, SPIE, Avaliação de defeitos (API 579/ASME B31.G), ASME B31.8/B31.8S, PIGs, SCC, soldagem e reparos, ArcGIS/Google Earth, gestão de riscos e contratos.

Diferencial

  • Atuação ou disponibilidade para atuar como PLH.
  • Certificações em inspeção/END/soldagem.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Participação em eventos e fóruns técnicos.

Oferecemos

  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Bolsa-auxílio e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado: Cartão flexível Alimentação/Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco Nacional e Odontológico Privian Master, Seguro de vida, Previdência Privada, Total Pass, Auxílio-medicamentos pelo Vidalink, Vale-presente, Vale-transporte, Ticket de Natal, Auxílio creche/babá e PLR.

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo

  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor e Business Partner: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com o Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.

title: Senior Media Partnerships Services Manager
description:
Department

Broadcast & Media Operations

Location

Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Head of Broadcast FIFA27 and Senior Partnerships Services Manager in Zurich HQ, the Senior Media Partnerships Services Manager FIFA27 will assume crucial responsibility in overseeing and facilitating the provision of services to FIFA’s Media Partners.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee and coordinate the preparation of all aspects of services provided to FIFA’s Media Partners in the Host Country, excluding host broadcast production. This encompassing role includes accommodation, accreditation, catering, customs, filming permits, frequency licensing, logistics, transportation, venue access control, visas, work permits, site visits, and more.
  • Contribute hiring and supervising the Media Partnerships Services Manager. Coordinate an event team consisting of 4-6 skilled staff members based at different stadiums.
  • Maintain effective communication and work closely with the Zurich-based Relations and Services department.
  • Forge collaborative partnership with the Host Broadcast Production colleagues to determine and implement optimal unilateral services across all broadcast venues (Stadiums, International Broadcast Coordination Center, FIFA Fan Fests, and beyond).
  • Cultivate enduring relationships with key functional areas of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, fostering synergies and ensuring smooth operation of essential services.
  • Work hand in hand with the Relations management team to address the specific needs of Media Partners during their visits to the Host Cities, providing comprehensive support throughout the preparation phase.
  • Support organising various workshops as well as venue tours.
  • Manage and coordinate services for numerous operations and milestone events leading up to the tournament, starting with the Draw in December 2026.
  • Contribute actively to the seamless delivery of services during the tournament, always ensuring the highest standards of excellence.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Master’s degree or similar higher education in Business and/or Sports Management or equivalent education.

Experience

  • 5-7 years of experience in a similar role.
  • Experience in the Sports industry is an advantage.
  • Experience in Broadcast environment is an advantage.
  • Experience of working in Brazil and knowledge of local culture will be an added benefit.
  • Experience in major sports events, such as the FIFA World Cup ™ or other FIFA events will be an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • ACCOUNTABILITY : We are looking for accountable individuals—people who take ownership of their responsibilities, follow through on commitments, and drive results with integrity. Individuals must be ready to step up, be reliable, and make a meaningful impact.
  • LEADERSHIP : We are seeking individuals with leadership qualities—those who inspire others, lead by example, and guide internal/external teams with confidence, empathy, and purpose to achieve set objectives under tight timelines.
  • INITIATIVE : We are seeking people with strong initiative—self-starters who take proactive steps, anticipate challenges, and go beyond what’s expected without waiting to be asked – who have the capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.
  • DECISION MAKING : We are seeking decisive individuals, with the ability to identify critical situations and swiftly make decisions, who take initiative and calculated risks, who explore alternative solutions, and react promptly to unforeseen circumstances.
  • INNOVATION : We are looking for innovative thinkers—individuals who challenge the status quo, bring fresh ideas, and find creative solutions to complex problems.
  • VISION : We are looking for visionary individuals—people who see the bigger picture, formulate strategic plans, think long-term, perceive the organization's global environmental impact and help shape bold ideas into reality.
  • INCLUSIVITY : We seek individuals who love teamwork, actively listen, embrace diverse perspectives, and help build collaborative, respectful teams.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Fluent in English and (Brazilian) Portugues. Any other language is a plus.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.) and online collaboration tools.
  • This position requires frequent travel to participate in meetings and venue tours.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Senior Manager, Ticketing Operations
description:
Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting organizationally to the Head of Ticketing the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager will work closely with the FIFA Ticketing team in Zurich to ensure the planning, implementation, and delivery of the ticketing operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. This role will be responsible for managing the ticketing operations at the stadiums and all ticketing facilities in the host country. Further, this role will oversee the creation and maintenance of seating maps in the ticketing system, as well as the assignment of ticket holders to seats in accordance with FIFA policies.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the Ticketing Operations team in Brazil in the overall tournament planning, ensuring the team has the guidance, resources, and support required to deliver their roles successfully.
  • Foster strong collaboration within the local team and with the Ticketing team in Zurich to ensure consistent operational alignment.
  • Implement system configuration according to the specifications set by the Zurich team, maintaining accuracy and consistency across all platforms.
  • Oversee and manage the ticketing inventory, including the creation, maintenance, and continuous updating of seating plans for all host venues in the ticketing system.
  • Plan, prepare, and supervise the full on‑site ticketing operation, including the setup and management of all required infrastructure and equipment.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain ticketing policies and procedures to ensure operational excellence and compliance with organizational standards.
  • Ensure alignment and coordination with other functional areas as well as the host stadium to support a seamless event delivery.
  • Oversee all electronic access control operations in the host venues, ensuring proper configuration, integration, and match‑day readiness.
  • Plan, schedule, and conduct site visits as required to assess operational needs, validate infrastructure, and coordinate with venue stakeholders.
  • Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events as required.

YOUR PROFILE

Education / Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in ticketing operations for major sports events, venues, or entertainment properties.
  • Experience delivering ticketing operations for multi‑venue events or international tournaments is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with ticketing platforms and access control technologies.
  • Strong operational planning and stakeholder coordination skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast‑paced event environment with multiple deadlines.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Native‑level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages is valued.

Skills & Competencies

  • Leadership and team management
  • Operational planning and execution
  • Stakeholder management
  • Problem solving and decision making
  • Communication and coordination
  • Attention to detail
  • Risk management mindset

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel to host cities.
  • Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time.
  • Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gestão do portfólio de produtos: acompanhar o desempenho comercial e de margem, propondo ações de mix, descontinuação ou ajustes de preço.

  • Planejamento de lançamentos: definir estratégias de entrada no mercado, pricing, metas de vendas e posicionamento junto ao time de marketing e comercial.
  • Gestão de indicadores: acompanhar KPIs, margem, giro e cobertura de estoque, elaborando planos de ação quando necessário.
  • Relacionamento interdepartamental: fazer interface constante com times de marketing, supply chain, comercial, e-commerce e visual merchandising, garantindo coerência e execução das estratégias de produto.
  • Apoio à liderança: contribuir com análises estratégicas e apresentações executivas para suportar decisões de negócio e roadmap de produtos.
  • Gestão do ciclo de vida: propor ações para maximizar o desempenho de cada produto — desde o lançamento até o eventual encerramento.
