description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.

Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente Sênior de Cloud para liderar nossa estratégia de infraestrutura em nuvem, garantindo escalabilidade, eficiência operacional, segurança e otimização de custos. Essa posição terá um papel fundamental na evolução da nossa plataforma tecnológica, apoiando diretamente a estratégia de produto e crescimento do negócio.

A pessoa ideal terá forte experiência em arquitetura cloud, liderança de times de engenharia e gestão de ambientes de alta escala, além de visão estratégica para impulsionar inovação e excelência operacional.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES:

  • Liderar e desenvolver times de Cloud Engineering, SRE e Platform Engineering ;
  • Definir e evoluir a estratégia de infraestrutura em nuvem da companhia;
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade, confiabilidade e performance dos sistemas;
  • Conduzir iniciativas de modernização de arquitetura , incluindo microservices, containers e serverless;
  • Gerenciar e otimizar custos de cloud através de práticas de FinOps ;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de Engenharia, Dados, Segurança e Produto ;
  • Evoluir práticas de observabilidade, automação e infraestrutura como código ;
  • Garantir aderência às melhores práticas de segurança e compliance ;
  • Liderar processos de capacity planning, incident management e disaster recovery ;
  • Apoiar a empresa na adoção de novas tecnologias e arquiteturas cloud-native.

Requisitos e qualificações

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Experiência liderando times de infraestrutura ou cloud engineering;
  • Forte conhecimento em plataformas de cloud pública AWS;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes, containers e arquiteturas distribuídas ;
  • Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, CloudFormation ou similares);
  • Experiência com práticas de SRE, observabilidade e automação ;
  • Conhecimento em segurança em cloud e boas práticas de arquitetura ;
  • Experiência com ambientes de alta escala e alta disponibilidade ;
  • Forte habilidade de liderança, comunicação e gestão de stakeholders;

Informações adicionais

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

title: Software Engineer - Python - Cloud - graduate level
description:
Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

Position

We are hiring a Software Engineer to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu on public clouds.

The quality and stability of Ubuntu is critically important, as it is available on every public cloud. You’ll work with teams across Canonical and major cloud partners to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu cloud images. You will also be a voice in communication with our users, ensuring their needs are met.

This role requires quality‑oriented software engineering in Python and a focus on software interoperability across a vast range of target releases and environments. Excellent Python skills are a key requirement, with previous contributions to open source Python projects being an advantage. The role involves creating and managing Ubuntu images; therefore, experience in configuring apt, knowledge of deb packaging and general system administration is advantageous.

Applicants should be passionate about the Ubuntu project and its values and about building tools that are used by millions worldwide. A personal interest and emphasis on quality, thinking of edge cases, ease of use, documentation, and careful community coordination is important. Ubuntu is used for a wide spectrum of users, from mission‑critical environments to hobbyist Ubuntu users; applicants should be ready to work with the whole spectrum of end users and help guide engineering best practices with them in mind.

Role Outline

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code, with unit and functional tests, to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and investigate to find good solutions
  • Work from home, with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self‑motivated
  • You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have extensive experience with Python on Linux
  • You have interest in and experience with two or more of the following: Ubuntu Linux systems administration, continuous integration, end‑system contract management, Debian packaging, working with public or on‑premise clouds
  • Bonus points if you have experience engaging with the open source community

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Concurso Perito e Investigador salários de até R$6.280,31
description:
Edital foi autorizado para concurso público de Perito e Investigador da Policia Civil do Rio de janeiro 2019. As 685 vagas estão divididas e 118 delas para o cargo de Investigador e as restantes, 567 para Inspetor da Policia Civil.

De acordo com o Governador do Estado do Rio foram autorizadas, além dessas, mais 400 vagas para o cargo de Técnico de Necropsia (80), Auxiliar de Necropsia (60), Perito (60) e Delegado (100).

Sobretudo, ainda não foi escolhida a banca organizadora, mas sabe-se que está em fase de propostas. De acordo com a Acadepol (Academia de Policia), oito bancas estão em analise para se decidir qual delas tomará conta do certame. O Concurso de Perito e Investigador terá salários de até R$6.280,31, confira tudo sobre os cargos e a prova.

Cargos concurso Perito e Investigador

Foto divulgação: Policiais Civis em serviço.

É fundamental que o candidato fique por dentro de todas as funções para o cargo que irá concorrer à vaga. Bem, em primeiro lugar é preciso saber quais as atribuições do cargo. Então agora vamos entender as funções, atribuições e também definições dos cargos em questão.

Concurso Perito e Investigador confira os cargos:

O correto é dizer é Auxiliar Policial de Necropsia da Polícia Civil, neste caso, cargo cujo nível de escolaridade exigido é o ensino fundamental. Sendo assim, os candidatos podem esperar por grande concorrência para o concurso público, isso porque o salário é de quase R$4.000,00 aproximadamente.

Atribuições

O Auxiliar de Necropsia é responsável pelo o serviço de limpeza de cadáveres, bem como a limpeza e manutenção do local onde vai trabalhar.

2-Técnico de Necropsia

O termo correto para esse cargo é Técnico Policial de Necropsia da Polícia Civil. Todavia, esse cargo exige um nível maior de escolaridade sendo assim o candidato terá que ter o ensino médio, ou seja, não precisa ter formação de técnico de necropsia para concorrer a vaga. Contudo, esse também será um cargo muito concorrido, bem como o de Auxiliar de Necropsia, pois o salário de mais de 5 mil reais aproximadamente.

Atribuições

O Técnico de Necropsia tem as funções de fazer a autópsia dos corpos e dissecação de cadáveres, sob supervisão direta de Peritos Policiais. Uma dúvida recorrente dos candidatos do Técnico e Auxiliar de Necropsia são sobre o porte de arma e a exigência de carteira de habilitação, nos últimos concursos não se exigia a carteira de motorista, é preciso esperar o edital para concluir essa informação. No entanto, o porte de arma é inerente aos servidores da Policia Civil.

As atividades do Inspetor de Policia é estar supervisionando e atento, pois irá coordenar os superiores em assuntos técnicos especializados e fiscalizar a operação. Além disso, a função de segurança, investigações e operações policiais.

As carreiras de Inspetor Policial podem ser de âmbito operacional, sendo assim, trabalham com as inteligências policiais e também administrativas nas delegacias.

Salário para Inspetor é de R$6.711,29, ou seja, uma remuneração bastante imponente. Para o cargo é exigido nível superior, e geralmente são chamados muitos candidatos.

O Investigador de Policia tem a remuneração inicial de R$ 6.108,85 aproximadamente. De acordo com notícias o cargo de Investigador passou por uma modificação e sofreia alterações no nível de escolaridade, mas a liminar foi derrubada e ficou sendo exigido nível médio, para a alegria de todos que já estavam estudando para o concurso.

Atribuições

Exercer com supervisão e autonomia coordenação e orientação do superior suas atividades de natureza relacionadas ao transporte de autoridades garantindo total segurança, entre outras funções básicas que estão de acordo com o edital do concurso.

5-Delegado de Polícia

O Delegado de Policia que fizer o Concurso Perito e Investigador, aprovado em todas as fases do iniciará seu trabalho cumprindo os seguintes deveres:

  • Concorrer para a manutenção da ordem pública;
  • Assegurar a observância da lei;
  • Defender as instituições públicas;
  • Promover a prevenção, a apuração e a repressão das infrações penais;
  • Assegurar o exercício pleno da cidadania e das liberdades individuais;
  • Exercer atividades de nível superior, compreendendo supervisão, planejamento, coordenação e controle, no mais alto nível de hierarquia da Administração Policial do Estado, entre outras funções conforme o edital.

Etapas do concurso

A prova tem quatro etapas, visto que a primeira a provaobjetiva, com as matérias de língua portuguesa, informática, constitucional,administrativo, penal e processo penal. Além de tudo, lei de drogas e estatutodo direito civil, tudo incluído no edital.

O concurso para Perito e Investigador é bastante almejado. Passando pela prova objetiva terá as outras três avaliações: psicotécnico, exame médico e prova de capacidade física. Logo após isso, entrará para a Acadepol para passar pela investigação social.

Resumo concurso Perito e Investigador Polícia Civil do Rio

O Concurso Perito e Investigador, para o cargo deAuxiliar de Necropsia daPolícia Civil/RJ ,. terá a exigência de nível fundamental e receberá uma remuneração de R$4.743,12. Já paraTécnico de Necropsia , é exigido nível médio para o salário de R$5.277,59.

OInspetor dePolícia Civil é necessário nível superior e os aprovados receberão o salário deR$6.280,31. O cargo de Investigador também exige a mesma escolaridade. Para oposto, o salário é de R$5.740,38.

A exigência para o cargo de Delegado, no Concurso Perito e Investigador é de nível superior em Direito, devendo com o diploma devidamente registrado para exercer a função com remuneração é de R$18.747,95.

Detalhes do concurso

  • Concurso : Perito e Investigador Estado do Rio de Janeiro (PC-RJ)
  • Escolaridade : fundamental, médio e superior

description:
A Cotesa tem como propósito ser a melhor parceira do setor elétrico brasileiro.

Tem como diretriz de atuação a máxima eficiência, aliada à responsabilidade socioambiental e à segurança de suas equipes, valores compartilhados por seus colaboradores.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Missão da Função

  • Prestar serviços de manutenção nas instalações, cumprindo os requisitos e processos internos com máxima qualidade e segurança.

Responsabilidade do Técnico de Manutenção II

  • Executar as manutenções preditivas, preventivas e corretivas em Usina e Subestações, realizando inspeções diárias, semanais, mensais, trimestrais, semestrais, anuais e plurianuais, cumprindo os procedimentos internos, identificando os desvios e sugerir as ações necessárias para o cumprimento e mantendo o Sistema de Gestão da Manutenção atualizado a fim de cumprir com o plano de manutenção e garantir a máxima confiabilidade e disponibilidade dos ativos.
  • Acompanhar as atividades de comissionamento e recepção de novos equipamentos de Usina e subestações, a fim de obter a liberação para entrada em operação.
  • Realizar o apontamento de defeitos/anomalias decorrentes das inspeções realizadas nas Instalações, no software de gerenciamento da manutenção, com objetivo de manter atualizado o planejamento de manutenções corretivas.
  • Zelar pelo bom uso e conservação das ferramentas e instrumentos de manutenção de Instalações, com objetivo de manter a segurança e o patrimônio da empresa.
  • Realizar o atendimento às emergenciais. Realizar o recebimento de materiais e equipamentos, conferindo com a nota fiscal, controlando, organizando, limpando e mantendo a boa conservação dos sobressalentes, cumprindo os procedimentos estabelecidos, sugerindo melhorias nas condições de armazenamento, objetivando manter o estoque nas melhores condições de utilização, executando inspeções especiais nas Instalações, localizando e identificando as causas de desligamentos automáticos, a fim de reestabelecer os equipamentos no menor prazo possível.
  • Conduzir os veículos da empresa cumprindo a legislação de trânsito e política de frotas, zelando pela segurança, pelo ativo e imagem da COTESA e do Cliente.
  • Cumprir as normativas legais e procedimentos internos, fazendo a correta utilização e conservação dos EPIs e EPC, atuando preventivamente na realização das atividades, identificando situações de risco, propondo ao seu superior imediato medidas de controle, a fim zelar pelas questões de saúde e segurança.
  • Contribuir para a elaboração dos relatórios mensais e técnicos, seguindo os padrões pré-estabelecidos pela engenharia, encaminhando para revisão do supervisor, a fim de cumprir os prazos e requisitos legais do contrato.
  • Fornecer informações técnicas decorrente de falhas e de desempenho de equipamentos e sistemas, relatando informações específicas, a fim de subsidiar a análise dos especialistas da área de Engenharia.
  • Reconhecer os eventos de natureza operativa, em horário de trabalho e quando comunicado pela Operação (tais como desligamentos automáticos, oscilações sistêmicas, alarmes de alta severidade, entre outros...), tomando as providências locais solicitadas pela Operação, afim de garantir máxima disponibilidade dos ativo.
  • Executar a operação local nas instalações tele controladas, quando houver perda da operação remota, atendendo aos procedimentos de rede, rotinas operacionais e as instruções de operação local, com objetivo de garantir a máxima disponibilidade dos ativos.
  • Contribuir para a conservação das instalações civis, a fim de garantir boas condições de infraestrutura para o adequado desenvolvimento das atividades.
  • Zelar pelo bom relacionamento entre agentes acessantes/acessada, visando atender os acordos operativos e de compartilhamento das instalações, com o objetivo de manter a máxima cooperação entre as partes.
  • Zelar pelo bom relacionamento com a equipe local do cliente, a fim de compatibilizar as demandas de serviços decorrentes de solicitações do mesmo e as demandas próprias.
  • Cumprir com as questões ambientais, orientando os demais colegas da equipe, a fim de atender a legislação e programas ambientais vigentes oriundos do licenciamento do empreendimento.
  • Participar da execução dos Planos de Contingência e/ou Planos de Atendimento a Emergências e/ou Planos de Segurança em Barragens, seguindo os procedimentos internos, identificando os desvios e implementando as ações necessárias para o cumprimento, dimensionando os recursos necessários, a fim de garantir a operacionalidade e segurança das pessoas e instalações.
  • Prestar atendimento e realizar outras atividades profissionais correlatas e inerentes ao cargo exercido, conforme orientação e/ou solicitação do superior imediato.

Responsabilidade do Técnico de Manutenção III

  • Desenvolverá todas as responsabilidades já descritas para o Técnico de Manutenção II e ainda:
  • Contribuir com o planejamento, coordenação e orientação para execução das atividades do demais colegas da equipe, a fim de garantir a segurança, qualidade do trabalho, o cumprimento dos prazos, metas e indicadores estabelecidos, bem como, identificar possibilidades de melhorias nos processos existentes.

Sobre a Empresa: Fundada em 2007, a GSS Segurança e Serviços consolidou-se como uma das referências no setor de segurança patrimonial e facilities no Brasil. Com sede em São Paulo e filial no Rio de Janeiro, nossa história é pautada pela entrega de soluções personalizadas e eficazes que trazem tranquilidade e proteção ao patrimônio de nossos clientes.

Atuamos com uma metodologia que une análise profunda de necessidades à tecnologia de ponta, oferecendo desde vigilância especializada até serviços de limpeza, portaria e recepção. Nossa trajetória é marcada pelo compromisso com a idoneidade e pelo reconhecimento do mercado como uma empresa ética e moderna.

Cultura e Equipe: Na GSS, acreditamos que nossos profissionais são os alicerces do nosso sucesso. Nossa cultura é fundamentada em quatro pilares essenciais: Respeito, Ética, Qualidade e Proatividade .

Somos defensores da humanização e da inclusão no setor de segurança e serviços. Orgulhamo-nos de adotar iniciativas como a cartilha "Segurança Sem Preconceito", reafirmando nosso compromisso com um ambiente de trabalho diverso e livre de discriminação.

Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você encontrará um ambiente colaborativo, focado em resultados e que valoriza a capacitação constante. Buscamos pessoas que tenham o desejo de crescer junto conosco e que compartilham da nossa paixão por servir com excelência e integridade.

Para dar continuidade ao preenchimento da vaga no Gupy para a GSS Segurança e Serviços , aqui está uma estrutura detalhada de responsabilidades e requisitos.

O texto foi elaborado para atrair um perfil que equilibre a capacidade técnica (manuseio de produtos e equipamentos) com a gestão humanizada , alinhada à cultura de ética e respeito da empresa.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Nesta função, o Supervisor será o responsável por garantir que a excelência operacional da GSS seja percebida diariamente pelo cliente. Suas principais atividades incluem:

  • Gestão de Equipes: Coordenar escalas de trabalho, controlar a frequência (faltas e substituições) e aplicar feedbacks constantes para manter o engajamento do time de limpeza.
  • Controle de Qualidade: Realizar rondas e inspeções técnicas frequentes nos postos de serviço para garantir que os padrões de higienização e conservação estejam sendo rigorosamente seguidos.
  • Gestão de Insumos: Monitorar o estoque de materiais de limpeza e EPIs, garantindo o uso consciente, a diluição correta de produtos químicos e a solicitação de reposição em tempo hábil.
  • Treinamento Operacional: Capacitar os colaboradores no manuseio de maquinários (enceradeiras, lavadoras de alta pressão, aspiradores industriais) e na aplicação de técnicas de limpeza técnica e hospitalar (se aplicável).

  • Interface com o Cliente: Atender prontamente as solicitações dos contratantes, resolvendo intercorrências operacionais com agilidade e reportando o status dos serviços através de relatórios técnicos.
  • Documentação Operacional: Preencher cronogramas, checklists de limpeza e relatórios de supervisão de forma organizada e digital.

O que é essencial (Requisitos):

  • Ensino Médio completo (Desejável curso técnico ou superior em Gestão de Facilities, Processos Gerenciais ou áreas correlatas).
  • Experiência comprovada em cargos de supervisão ou liderança operacional no segmento de limpeza e conservação.
  • Conhecimento técnico avançado em produtos químicos (diluição, PH, superfícies) e operação de máquinas de limpeza industrial.
  • Domínio básico/intermediário do Pacote Office (especialmente Excel para controle de estoque e escalas).
  • Possuir CNH ativa (categoria B ou superior) e disponibilidade para deslocamento entre diferentes postos de serviço.
  • Perfil proativo, com excelente comunicação e capacidade de resolução de conflitos.

O que será um diferencial (Desejável):

  • Conhecimento em normas de segurança (como NR-35 para trabalho em altura ou NR-06 para EPIs).

title: Procurement Coordinator
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"). For the first time ever, it will be hosted in South America in Brazil. This is your chance to be part of a workforce creating an unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Finance

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position

The Procurement Coordinator for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 will support the implementation of the FIFA27 Procurement Policy, ensuring organization-wide compliance through ongoing employee training and adherence checks. Responsibilities include creating Purchase Orders (POs) in SAP, supporting RFI/RFP processes, driving inter‑departmental alignment, and managing the FIFA27 SAP cost contract database to deliver cost efficiency and compliance across the FIFA procurement landscape.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement the FIFA27 Procurement Policy and procedures across the organization. Act as gatekeeper of the process at the relevant stages.
  • Train employees on an on-going basis to ensure adherence to FIFA27 Procurement Policy.
  • Maintain the SAP cost contract database, including entering and maintaining contract data and creation of Purchase Orders (POs).
  • Manage (solve or forward) queries raised to the FIFA27 Procurement team mailbox.
  • Support project leaders in all procurement matters, including setting up RFIs and RFPs.
  • Create spend reports for management as requested.
  • Conduct administrative activities of the procurement team.

Your Profile

  • Terciary education in Business Administration, Procurement and/or extensive experience in indirect procurement.
  • Minimum 1 year experience in a similar role.
  • Good SAP MM knowledge is an asset.
  • Knowledge of DocuSign is an asset.
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow is an asset.
  • High standard of attention to detail.
  • Practical mindset and solution oriented.
  • Capable of working in an environment of rapid change, tight deadlines and high scrutiny.
  • Understands the application of governance and compliance.
  • Understands key contract elements and contractual language.
  • Tolerance to repetitive work.
  • Organized, able to prioritize workloads.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Mechanical CADD Technician
description:
Moffatt & Nichol specializes in large complex waterfront infrastructure projects and is recognized as one of the worldwide leaders in this field. We are actively looking for a Junior level, Mechanical Designer Technician to join our Rio de Janeiro or Sao Paulo office. As part of the Mechanical Group, the Mechanical Engineer Designer will have experience with solid bulk conveyance systems, hydraulic modelling and design of liquid bulk transmission systems, as well as utility (water / sewer / stormwater) systems. Experience in industrial complex and / or marine terminals are a plus.

About Moffatt & Nichol

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading infrastructure advisor specialising in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines. Reflecting Moffatt & Nichol’s commitment to design innovation since 1945, Engineering News-Record (ENR) has ranked the company No. 1 design firm for Marine and Port Facilities in the United States and No. 7 internationally.

Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists, and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, the Americas, the Middle East and Asia Pacific. The firm provides clients worldwide with customised service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in three primary practise areas—coastal, environmental, and water resources; ports and harbours; and transportation, bridges, and rail.

Duties And Responsibilities

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

  • To prepare a variety of designs from Agri bulk material, and mining bulk in Port Terminals or industrial plants
  • To prepare a variety of designs in waterfront facilities such as marinas, container terminals, marine oil terminals and pump stations and utilities (firefighting / water / sewer / stormwater) systems projects
  • To perform hydraulic modelling and analysis of liquid bulk transmission systems and utility (water / sewer / stormwater) systems
  • Preparing design documents (plans and specifications) with an emphasis on utility service design
  • To design other projects such as piping to support in other projects such as liquid bulk terminal and utilities which will include piping design using either Plant 3D or similar software
  • To generate proposals and develop fee estimates for PS&E packages
  • To assist with condition assessment inspections for terminals equipment and utilities infrastructure

Other Duties

Please note this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering (Desirable)
  • 2-6 years of experience in mechanical design related to bulk material handling
    • Experience in 3D piping design required
    • Plant 3D or equivalent (PDMS, PDS, etc.) experience required
  • Design experience in industrial complex and / or marine terminals is a plus
  • General understanding of process design, process flow diagram development, and piping and instrumentation diagram (P&ID) development
  • Acknowledgement in developing equipment specification, calculation, data sheets, drawings reviews and other documents related to mechanical design
  • Some planning and task management skills
  • Complete piping and pipelines stress analysis using CAESAR is a plus
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English. Spanish is an advantage
  • All new hires will be required to successfully complete and pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check in compliance with NIST 800-171

Working Conditions

Sedentary for prolonged period of time, interact with clients, and travel occasionally.

Moffatt & Nichol’s EEO Statement

We draw from the world’s best and brightest, regardless of geographic, cultural, or institutional background. This approach enables us to better understand and serve our clients, foster innovation, and create a rich, collaborative work environment. title: Senior Manager, Ticketing Operations
description:
Senior Manager, Ticketing Operations

Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting organizationally to the Head of Ticketing the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager will work closely with the FIFA Ticketing team in Zurich to ensure the planning, implementation, and delivery of the ticketing operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. This role will be responsible for managing the ticketing operations at the stadiums and all ticketing facilities in the host country. Further, this role will oversee the creation and maintenance of seating maps in the ticketing system, as well as the assignment of ticket holders to seats in accordance with FIFA policies.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the Ticketing Operations team in Brazil in the overall tournament planning, ensuring the team has the guidance, resources, and support required to deliver their roles successfully.
  • Foster strong collaboration within the local team and with the Ticketing team in Zurich to ensure consistent operational alignment.
  • Implement system configuration according to the specifications set by the Zurich team, maintaining accuracy and consistency across all platforms.
  • Oversee and manage the ticketing inventory, including the creation, maintenance, and continuous updating of seating plans for all host venues in the ticketing system.
  • Plan, prepare, and supervise the full on‑site ticketing operation, including the setup and management of all required infrastructure and equipment.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain ticketing policies and procedures to ensure operational excellence and compliance with organizational standards.
  • Ensure alignment and coordination with other functional areas as well as the host stadium to support a seamless event delivery.
  • Oversee all electronic access control operations in the host venues, ensuring proper configuration, integration, and match‑day readiness.
  • Plan, schedule, and conduct site visits as required to assess operational needs, validate infrastructure, and coordinate with venue stakeholders.
  • Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events as required.

YOUR PROFILE

Education / Experience
  • 8+ years of experience in ticketing operations for major sports events, venues, or entertainment properties.
  • Experience delivering ticketing operations for multi‑venue events or international tournaments is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with ticketing platforms and access control technologies.
  • Strong operational planning and stakeholder coordination skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast‑paced event environment with multiple deadlines.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Native‑level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages is valued.
Skills & Competencies
  • Leadership and team management
  • Operational planning and execution
  • Stakeholder management
  • Problem solving and decision making
  • Communication and coordination
  • Attention to detail
  • Risk management mindset
Certifications & Requirements
  • Willingness to travel to host cities.
  • Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time.
  • Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
Senior Graphic Designer

Department: Communications

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Graphic designer at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will play a pivotal role in shaping the expression of the FIFA brand across global platforms and live event environments. You will lead the creative development and localisation of Brand Graphic assets ensuring consistent, world-class creative output aligned with FIFA’s strategic brand objectives. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football. Purpose of the Role: This role combines world class graphic design excellence, strong project management skills, and a deep understanding of global audiences, especially in the realm of sports and entertainment. This role reports to the Global head of Brand, marketing & promotions and acts as an extension to the Brand team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines. Solid experience in Graphic Design in brand development context is mandatory.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Graphic Design & Brand Expression

  • Own, drive and oversee creative process and localisation across channels ensuring high-quality outcomes aligned with FIFA’s brand vision.
  • Inline with Brand Guidelines and central Brand direction, direct and produce creative content across brand graphics, event branding, venue dressing, broadcast environments, digital experiences, motion design, and video content.
  • Develop key visuals, brand toolkits, motion graphics packages, environmental branding concepts, and digital-first creative assets.

Project Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Lead junior designer and external creative partners to deliver cohesive, high-impact work across formats and platforms.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders and external partners to align creative outputs with business and brand objectives.
  • Brief, manage, and evaluate external agencies, production partners, ensuring creative alignment and production quality.

Brand Guardianship & Design Systems

  • Ensure strict adherence to FIFA’s visual identity standards, while pushing creative boundaries within those frameworks.

YOUR PROFILE

Education & Qualifications

  • Degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related creative discipline.
  • Proven HANDS -ON expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro).
  • Important : Experience working with large-scale brand projects, live events, from concepting event look & feel to developing venue branding systems.
  • Minimum 8-10 years of experience in senior graphic or art direction roles within agency, sports events or Entertainment.

Competencies and Personality

Creative Expertise

  • Graphic Design solid experience in the context of Brand creation and brand assets and collateral
  • Deep visual sensibility and an understanding of brand identity systems across static, dynamic, and environmental media.
  • High-level conceptual thinker with a passion for visual storytelling, motion language, and digital engagement.
  • Hands-on graphic skills, capable of leading from the front while mentoring junior creatives.

Executional Rigor

  • Skilled at balancing creative ambition with operational precision and production feasibility.

Creative Expertise

title: Asbestos Surveyor
description:
Shape Safer Environments Through Technical Excellence

Every building has a story hidden within its structure. As an Asbestos Surveyor, you’ll be the person who uncovers the detail, applies technical expertise and ensures that clients across the UK can make informed, safe and confident decisions. If you enjoy autonomy, thrive in varied environments and take pride in accuracy and clarity, this role offers genuine scope to grow, influence and create meaningful impact.

We have multiple roles available that will either cover locations across the Southeast and London or solely cover the Darlington area in the Northeast. In addition to the very competitive salary and overtime rates, we also offer a company car or a car allowance, giving you the flexibility and support you need for your role.

Purpose & Scope of the Role

This role exists to deliver high quality, UKAS compliant asbestos surveying services across a wide-ranging portfolio of commercial and industrial properties. You will carry out management, refurbishment and demolition surveys, collecting precise inspection data and producing clear, robust reports aligned with UKAS accreditation and HSE guidance. Working largely independently on client sites, you will conduct detailed inspections, bulk sampling and risk assessments, offering technically sound insights that support compliance, risk control and asset management. You will work closely with internal quality and project teams while interacting directly with clients, facilities personnel and other stakeholders.

Reporting to the Regional Operations Manager, you will operate across offices, public buildings, retail, healthcare, education, manufacturing and infrastructure environments. The role involves travelling to multiple sites, managing personal workloads and deadlines, and ensuring exceptional data integrity. All work is supported by digital surveying tools, structured reporting systems and a mature quality assurance framework.

Your Impact in This Position

In the early stages, you will establish yourself as a dependable technical specialist, delivering consistently high quality surveys and building trusted relationships with both clients and colleagues. As your experience deepens, you will gain exposure to larger, more complex survey projects and play a part in service improvements and broader consultancy activities. This includes involvement in major commercial and industrial projects, reinspection projects and asbestos management reviews.

Longer‑term, this position offers multiple progression pathways, including senior surveying responsibilities, technical auditing, project management or leadership roles within the consultancy. Ongoing professional development and access to diverse sites and contracts provide a strong foundation for sustained career growth.

Core Capabilities

  • Asbestos Surveying – Plan and deliver comprehensive management, refurbishment and demolition surveys across commercial and industrial environments, identifying and sampling asbestos‑containing materials with precision.
  • Asbestos Expertise – Serve as the trusted technical authority, understanding asbestos materials, behaviours and associated risks across demanding sectors such as aviation, pharmaceuticals and utilities.
  • Regulatory Compliance and Technical Knowledge – Apply asbestos legislation and industry standards with confidence, ensuring every survey is compliant, proportionate and grounded in evidence.
  • Data Capturing, Reporting & Quality Assurance – Record detailed observations, assessments and sample information using digital platforms, and produce well‑structured technical reports that reflect attention to detail and clarity.
  • Client Communication & Consultancy Skills – Communicate technical findings clearly and professionally, fostering trust and providing proportionate, actionable advice to clients, facilities teams and project managers.

Qualifications & Experience

You will hold BOHS P402 or an equivalent RSPH qualification, along with demonstrable experience of undertaking asbestos surveys within a UKAS accredited setting. You will already be authorised for management, refurbishment and demolition surveys and bring strong IT, literacy and numeracy skills. A full UK driving licence is essential.

Working Environment

We support flexible arrangements, including three or four day working weeks. Overtime opportunities may be available and are remunerated at enhanced rates. You will plan site visits in advance to support effective scheduling and maintain a healthy work‑life balance. Periodic office attendance is expected for collaboration, training, quality reviews and wider team engagement. The role involves regular travel to client sites and occasional support for out‑of‑hours projects.

Why join Tetra Tech?

Tetra Tech is a leading provider of consulting and engineering services working across the full project lifecycle worldwide. We have a wide range of expertise across our teams, providing a global support network with a personalised approach to client relationships to better understand where we can add value. We provide a collaborative environment that supports individual performance, innovation, and creativity.

We support public and private sector clients on local, national, and international projects to deliver sustainable and resilient solutions. Our operations in the UK, Ireland, and the Netherlands include more than 6,000 employees who are Leading with Science® to solve our clients’ most complex problems.

In alignment with the Equality Act 2010, we will make reasonable adjustments to support candidates and employees requiring additional arrangements. This could include adaptations to work schedules, training approaches, or the physical workspace. Please inform us if you need any accommodations during the recruitment process or in your day‑to‑day role.

Recruitment Agencies

We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on this list and any submitted will be taken as a gift. Please refer to the careers page on our website if you require any further information.

Our ideal candidate would demonstrate an understanding of software development concepts and development lifecycles using Agile methodologies, object-oriented design, and accepted design patterns and practices.   • An analytical mindset with superior problem-solving abilities and a strong inclination to learn and implement new techniques.

  • Practical understanding of model selection, prompt strategy, output validation, and safe handling of proprietary or sensitive information.
  • Evidence of measurable outcomes from AI-enabled engineering (faster delivery cycles, stronger test posture, and reduced production defects).

Additional Information

title: Analista SRE/DevOps
description:
Quem somos?

A Incentive.me é uma plataforma tecnológica de engajamento da força de vendas que permite alcançar um novo patamar na Gestão de Incentivos. Conectamos empresas avendedores ao longo de toda a cadeia, até a ponta no varejo, criando campanhas de incentivo eficazes que transformam comportamentos e aumentam as vendas. Nosso objetivo é impulsionar uma cultura voltada para performance e resultados.

Quem procuramos?

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar com SRE/DevOps, apoiando a operação, evolução e automação dos nossos ambientes e serviços. Procuramos alguém com boa base técnica, raciocínio lógico, curiosidade real e vontade de aprender constantemente. Mais do que alguém que apenas siga tutoriais, buscamos uma pessoa que goste de entender como as tecnologias funcionam na prática, saiba investigar problemas e tenha maturidade para evoluir com autonomia. Você vai atuar em temas como cloud, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observabilidade, troubleshooting, documentação técnica e boas práticas de segurança.

  • Contato com observabilidade com ferramentas como Grafana e PrometheusExperiência com IaC e automações
  • Capacidade de automatizar tarefas com scripts e linguagens de programação

M3 Global Research, an M3 company, is seeking a Senior Data Engineer with SQL DBA expertise to join our data engineering team. This role will primarily focus on database administration (DBA) tasks such as optimization, performance tuning, and security.

The ideal candidate will have strong SQL database administration expertise. While direct Power BI development is not required, the candidate should be able to guide and support the team’s work and ensure alignment with business objectives.

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that Power BI and data solutions meet business objectives.
  • Mentor team members and drive best practices in data management and reporting.

Qualifications

  • Strong SQL database administration expertise (performance tuning, security, backup/recovery).
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills to work with both technical and non-technical teams.

  • Problem-solving mindset with a strong attention to detail.

AI and Automation Expectations

  • Strong hands-on experience with modern AI models and developer tooling to improve software delivery speed and quality.
  • Ability to use AI effectively for SQL performance tuning, database reliability validation, migration planning, and operational runbook automation.
  • Experience applying AI to testing workflows, including test scenario generation, regression coverage expansion, and edge-case identification.

  • Track record of measurable efficiency gains (faster cycle times, improved stability, reduced operational toil, or better delivery predictability).

Engagement Model

Department

Workforce, People & Culture

Location

Brazil

The Position

Reporting to the Volunteer Communications & Engagement Manager, the Volunteer Communications and Engagement Coordinator will play a key role in shaping the volunteer experience for thousands of volunteers across the eight host cities. You will help integrate, craft, and deliver inspiring, informative, and consistent messaging that keeps our volunteers engaged and connected throughout their journey — before, during, and after the tournament.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the daily operations of the Volunteer Communications and Engagement team by assisting the Communications & Engagement Manager with internal and external deliverables. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, copywriting emails, dashboards, articles, and newsletters in both English and Portuguese; updating communications on the volunteer platform; coordinating content for social media and internal channels; and providing additional support as needed.
  • Update and maintain the Volunteer Platform (Volunteer Management System) according to the communication needs of each Volunteer journey milestone, ensuring all content and templates are accurate and ready for use.
  • Contribute to the development and execution of communication strategies that foster volunteer engagement across all phases of the programme. From application, recruitment, role offer, training until the end of the tournament and their participation.
  • Support the design and delivery of a comprehensive volunteer engagement strategy, including key messaging and content pillars aligned with the tournament’s values.
  • Support the development and delivery of the Recognition Programme, including overseeing orders and brand approvals for volunteer gifts.
  • Draft and edit compelling content, including volunteer guides, FAQs, and platform updates, tailored for internal platforms, social media, and volunteer contact centres.
  • Coordinate content production, including graphic design requests and translation workflows (English, Portuguese).
  • Create editorial content for key channels such as the FIFA Volunteer Instagram, FIFA Home, and the FWWC2027 Volunteer Newsletter.
  • Assist in planning and executing volunteer events and promotional activities that build community and enhance the volunteer experience.
  • Provide administrative and project support across the Volunteer Communications team and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders as needed.
  • Support planning and development of a content plan for the different milestones.
  • Coordinate and support the collection, curation, and writing of volunteer profiles, stories, captions, and visual narratives for the “Volunteer Profile Bank”, capturing content from volunteers in all eight host cities.
  • Help organize and coordinate volunteer participation in media activities, interviews, and events.
  • Organize, curate, and maintain an updated library of volunteer-related assets (brand identity files, photos, videos, templates, guidelines, etc.).
  • Ensure all assets are easy to locate, properly labelled, and accessible to the team.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Project Management, or related field, or similar level of higher education
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in a communications function
  • Experience in operating a Volunteer Management Platform or CRM
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, both oral and written
  • Ability to see the big picture and adapt accordingly
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
  • Demonstrates strong attention to detail in all tasks and deliverables

  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project), planning software, and online collaboration tools

title: Content Services Liaison Manager
description:
Content Services Liaison Manager

Department: Partnerships & Media

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Content Services Liaison Manager will report jointly to the Zurich-based FWWC Content Services Project Lead. The successful candidate will be responsible for the planning and coordination of all event-related video content production, as well as ensuring the successful delivery of pre-event and in-tournament video content to FIFA stakeholders.

The Content Services Liaison Manager will be the in-country point of contact for all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives or stadium authorities and FIFA’s Media Partners in relation to non-live content services.

The successful individual will work closely with the FIFA Content Services team at FIFA HQ, Zurich to develop content strategies for the event, as well as communicating the confirmed content plans (long-form, short-form, social, audio) to all relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include 1 year to go, the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, 100 days to go and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and long operational hours. The selected candidate will also be expected to elevate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan, coordinate and oversee all pre-event content production based on the overall tournament content-plan developed in close collaboration with the FIFA Content Services Team in Zurich.
  • Ensure all content creation and delivery for the tournament is communicated clearly and promoted to all stakeholders.
  • Liaise with the FIFA team in Zurich around the creation and distribution of all future content. Report all developments to the Head of Production and work closely with all areas of the FIFA content team.
  • Liaise closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts to ensure they are informed about and engaged with all filming projects and that their individual content requirements are taken care of.
  • Potentially liaise with the North- and South American Media Partners (MP) to coordinate the delivery of produced content, discuss long and short-form programming opportunities and social media packages and assets – to be done in conjunction with FIFA Zurich.
  • Investigate new North and South American based opportunities around potential long and short-form programming, branded content, social media and audio projects, including podcasts.
  • Lead weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, manage and resolve risks and issues for FWWC content services related topics within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and FIFA Content Services Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Work across multiple time zones, to support the FIFA Content Services Project Lead based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio de Janeiro FIFA office.
  • Work closely with the local Host Broadcast and Media Partnerships department as their main point of contact for any FIFA Content Services related topics.
  • Pre-plan, onsite support and supervision of the content production for the Play off Final tournaments, the Final Draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.

YOUR PROFILE

  • A strong background in editorial sports television production or sports television production management.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a producer or production manager in a comparable content production related role within a fast-paced environment involving complex projects – ideally at a similar international sports event.
  • A knowledge of and participation in the South American Sports TV industry.
  • Contacts within the national football associations in South America.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organization.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Highly organized and proven to be cool‑headed under pressure.
  • Must have legal right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to relocate and work from Rio de Janeiro.
  • Required language skills: fluent in English and Portuguese is mandatory, fluent in Spanish is a big plus.

Qualifications

AI and Automation Expectations

  • Experience applying AI to testing workflows, including test scenario generation, regression coverage expansion, and edge‑case identification.

  • Comfortable evaluating AI output quality, selecting the right model/tool for the task, and using secure patterns for sensitive data.
  • Track record of measurable efficiency gains (faster cycle times, improved stability, reduced operational toil, or better delivery predictability).

Engagement Model

Já pensou em fazer parte de uma rotina totalmente dinâmica, e com foco principal em relacionamento e encantamento de clientes ? Confira nossa oportunidade:

Sobre a posição:

A sua missão será gerir unidades da Livance e a comunidade de membros que atendem conosco. Esta função será realizada presencialmente e em colaboração com a equipe de Especialistas e Líder da Unidade. Nossos clientes atendem seus pacientes em nossas unidades e se conectam no coworking, e você será essencial para integrar essa dinâmica.

O que faz o Especialista em Experiência do Cliente Presencial (Volante)?

Ser Volante significa atuar em diversas unidades da Livance no Rio de Janeiro conforme a agenda semanal, proporcionando uma rotina dinâmica e aprendizado profundo sobre nossa operação.

É inegociável que você tenha disponibilidade total para atuar nos períodos Manhã x Tarde, Intermediário ou Tarde x Noite e em todas unidades da Livance em RJ . Confira mais detalhes sobre as regiões de nossas unidades no nosso site:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será a sua rotina:

  • Atuar nas unidades Livance de acordo com as necessidades operacionais (cronograma semanal, em que unidades e horários podem mudar conforme demanda). Disponibilidade total é imprescindível.
  • Cultivar relacionamentos presenciais com os clientes, respondendo rapidamente às dúvidas e necessidades, e contribuindo para um ambiente acolhedor e positivo.
  • Fomentar a comunidade da unidade, construindo uma sólida rede de relacionamento entre os (as) clientes e conectando uns aos outros.
  • Realizar as reuniões de Boas Vindas (Onboardings), proporcionando a experiência Livance;
  • Garantir o bom funcionamento da unidade, cuidando da infraestrutura e oferecendo um atendimento de qualidade;
  • Integrar a cultura da Livance em todos os aspectos da operação da unidade.
  • Conduzir visitas guiadas para novos clientes (leads);
  • Zelar pela estrutura física da Unidade, fazendo rondas diárias na unidade, solicitando manutenção e abrindo chamados ao time de tecnologia quando necessário.
  • Colaborar estreitamente com outras áreas, incluindo Facilities, Marketing, Vendas, Tech, People e Financeiro, para garantir a integração das operações.
  • Atuar como facilitador(a) para a resolução de problemas entre os clientes e as áreas internas.
  • Gestão do Sistema: Gestão da plataforma de atendimentos, controlando as alocações de sala e impactos.

Requisitos e qualificações

Se você possui as habilidades abaixo, essa vaga é pra você!

  • Encantamento: Transformar cada interação em uma experiência memorável para nossos clientes;
  • Dinamismo: Ajustar-se a diferentes contextos e desafios;
  • Curiosidade e aprendizado contínuo: Estar sempre disposto(a) a aprender e se desenvolver;
  • Saber trabalhar em time: Fomentar uma cultura de apoio mútuo e manter bons relacionamentos interpessoais;
  • Familiaridade com tecnologia, para atuação no dia a dia com as ferramentas e sistemas;
  • Experiência em lidar diretamente com clientes (presencialmente);
  • Flexibilidade de horário e locomoção (posição volante, de rotina dinâmica).

Diferencial:

Experiência na área da saúde: concierge, gerontologia, hotelaria, líder de recepção ou áreas relacionadas à experiência do cliente presencialmente.

title: Containerization & Virtualisation Engineer
description:
About Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times a year in person in interesting locations around the world to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable and growing.

Technology Focus

This is a general selection process for software engineers focused on virtualisation and container technology – from the kernel through userspace. Apply if you are an exceptional Go, Rust or C/C++ engineer and want to work on next‑generation open source VMM or container technology, or related open source networking and storage. Container, virtualisation and cloud infrastructure are essential for modern software deployments. We invest in open source related to application isolation, workload orchestration, system or OCI containers, micro‑service architecture, or cloud infrastructure.

Here are some examples of projects underway at Canonical:

  • RustVMM – a new hypervisor for Linux focused on performance, security and operability.
  • Rockcraft – an elevated Docker image experience for the open source community.
  • LXD – a modern system container and virtual machine manager used on Ubuntu, ChromeOS and other Linux platforms, covering low‑level kernel work, filesystems, VMMs, networking, and higher‑level REST API and CLI.
  • Kubernetes (MicroK8s & Charmed Kubernetes) – building on‑rail K8s, Charmed Kubernetes, and operations tooling.
  • OpenStack (Charmed OpenStack, OVN/OVS, Ceph) – delivering cloud platform technologies to large‑scale computing environments.

These teams hire system‑level C/C++, Go, Rust and Python developers to work on security‑critical, performance‑critical and mission‑critical code, focused on software delivery, containers, security, sandboxing, application orchestration and management.

Location

We have remote container and virt engineering roles in every time zone.

What You Will Focus On

  • Design and specify new features, building consensus on approach.
  • Engage with upstream communities in your area of expertise.
  • Conduct security analysis and reviews to ensure defence in depth.
  • Create and monitor performance benchmarks to optimise your product.
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team.
  • Write high‑quality code to create new features.
  • Debug issues and produce high‑quality code to fix them.
  • Review code produced by other engineers.
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions.

What We Are Looking For in You

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about an alternative path.
  • Drive and a track record of going above and beyond expectations.
  • Experience working on open‑source virtualisation or container technology.
  • Experience working in the kernel or very low‑level system.
  • Professional written and spoken English.
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred).
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self‑motivation.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments.
  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events up to two weeks each.

Additional Skills We Value

  • Performance engineering and security experience.

What We Offer You

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Lead IT Engineer - Service Management
description:
About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America — and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Learn more at

About The Team

The IT team is the operational backbone of Nubank’s internal infrastructure. As the company scales, we’re building the service management foundations that let engineering teams move faster with more confidence — turning IT operations into a strategic advantage, not just a support function.

About The Role

As a Lead IT Engineer - Service Management, you will own and evolve Nubank’s IT Service Management (ITSM) practice end to end. You’ll design and implement processes, tools, and governance that keep our internal services reliable, auditable, and efficient, enabling engineering teams to focus on high‑impact work while maintaining strong operational controls in a regulated environment.

You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Continuing to build and own Nubank's ITSM practice, defining and implementing core ITIL v4 processes: incident, problem, change, service request, and knowledge management.
  • Establishing a service catalog with clearly defined SLAs and OLAs aligned with internal stakeholder expectations.
  • Owning the end-to-end ITSM toolchain (Jira Service Management or equivalent): configuration, workflow design, form logic, SLA rules, and integrations with adjacent systems.
  • Identifying and closing automation gaps — routing, escalation, notifications, and reporting — partnering with engineering teams to reduce manual toil across operations.
  • Defining and tracking operational KPIs (MTTR, SLA compliance, first-contact resolution, change success rate) and building regular reporting cadences for leadership and stakeholders.
  • Establishing a Change Advisory Board (CAB) with structured documentation and approval workflows.
  • Supporting audit and compliance requirements with structured evidence of IT operational controls, essential in a regulated financial environment.
  • Driving ITSM adoption across the organization, creating runbooks, training materials, and documentation that embed service management culture at scale.

Mandatory Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in IT service management, IT operations, or a related discipline.
  • Deep ITIL v4 expertise; ITIL 4 Foundation or Managing Professional certification strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record of building ITSM practices from scratch or significantly transforming an existing function.
  • Hands‑on experience owning and configuring ITSM tooling end-to-end (Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or equivalent) — not just using it, but designing it.
  • Ability to work cross‑functionally in a fast‑paced, engineering‑led environment, with strong influence‑without‑authority skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to present to senior leadership.

Nice‑to‑have Qualifications

  • Experience in fintech, high‑growth tech, or other regulated industries.
  • Familiarity with adjacent frameworks: COBIT, ISO 20000, or SRE principles.
  • Experience partnering with Security and/or Platform Engineering teams.
  • Fluent English.

What We Offer

  • Greenfield, high‑visibility scope: you’ll define what “good” ITSM looks like at Nubank’s scale — from zero.
  • Direct exposure to senior leadership across IT and Engineering.
  • A culture that values ownership and getting foundations right, without bureaucracy for its own sake.

Our Benefits – Brazil

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank
  • Food/Meal Card (Vale‑Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)
  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale‑Transporte)
  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program
  • Life Insurance
  • Medical Plan
  • Dental Plan
  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program
  • Nucleo – Our learning platform of courses
  • Extended Parental Leave
  • Daycare Allowance
  • Parental Consultancy
  • Work‑from‑home Allowance
  • Gym Partnerships
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

(For hybrid roles, commuting‑related benefits such as Vale‑Transport and gym partnerships remain applicable.)

Work Model for This Role

Hybrid – 2–3 times per week in the office.

Explore How We Build Technology At Nubank

  • building.nubank.com.br
  • youtube.com/@building.nubank
  • Our stories on Spotify

Diversity & Inclusion

At Nubank, we want to be sure that we’re building a more diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the customers we serve and seek to empower. That’s why we hire based on equality. We consider gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexual orientation, and other identity markers as enriching elements to our company, while ensuring none of them represent a barrier when recruiting fantastic talent.

How to Apply

If you’re excited about building a robust IT Service Management foundation that enables Nubank to scale with reliability and speed, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and help us shape the future of financial services in Latin America.

description:
Hey there! We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment. Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting‑edge technology and data‑driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award‑winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar‑raisers with a hands‑on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment! Ready to be part of the experience? Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About The Role

Fever has a fantastic Affiliate Program which allows us to partner up with a variety of third‑parties, and establish a long‑term, performance‑based partnership with them. Your main responsibility will be to manage these internal and external stakeholders, like bloggers, media groups, hotels, and airlines, etc. You will be working hand in hand with the rest of the Marketing team to help drive Fever’s growth on a global scale.

  • Grow and optimise existing affiliate collaborations, establishing successful and long‑term partnerships.

  • Account manage new affiliate partnerships, from commercial negotiations through to technical integrations and optimisations.
  • Closely monitor affiliate activity and performance, including carrying out fraud checks.

About You

  • Bachelor´s degree in Marketing, Communications or related field

  • Professional working proficiency in English and Portuguese. A third language is a plus.
  • Dynamic, proactive, and ambitious
  • Solution‑focused
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • An untamable desire to learn more

Benefits & Perks

  • Attractive compensation package and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.
  • Opportunity to have a real impact in a high‑growth global category leader.
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Life insurance.
  • Wellhub membership.
  • English lessons.
  • Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth.
  • Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

description:
Descrição da vaga

A Vibra Energia é uma das maiores distribuidoras de energia do Brasil e tem a inovação como um de seus pilares estratégicos para geração de valor, eficiência operacional e desenvolvimento de novos negócios. Por meio do Vibra colab, seu hub de inovação, a companhia conecta startups, parceiros tecnológicos e áreas internas para desenvolver soluções digitais e novos modelos de negócio que ampliem a competitividade e a transformação do setor energético. Buscamos um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Aplicações Pleno para atuar no time de inovação, responsável por estruturar e evoluir arquiteturas tecnológicas para produtos digitais, plataformas e iniciativas de transformação digital. Este(a) profissional atuará na concepção técnica de soluções escaláveis, integração entre sistemas e construção de MVPs e plataformas digitais, conectando tecnologia, estratégia de negócio e inovação.

O que oferecemos: Participação em iniciativas estratégicas de inovação e transformação digital com alto impacto para o negócio. Atuação em projetos que conectam tecnologia, novos modelos de negócio e inovação aberta. Ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico e conectado ao ecossistema de inovação e tecnologia. Oportunidade de influenciar a arquitetura tecnológica e a evolução digital da companhia. Um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, diverso e respeitoso, que valoriza diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Definir e evoluir arquiteturas de sistemas e aplicações para soluções digitais e plataformas estratégicas da companhia.
  • Projetar arquiteturas escaláveis, seguras e resilientes, considerando integração entre sistemas corporativos, APIs, microserviços e plataformas externas.
  • Atuar na concepção técnica de novos produtos digitais, desde a ideação e MVP até sua evolução e escalabilidade.
  • Liderar a definição de padrões tecnológicos, boas práticas de arquitetura e integração dentro das iniciativas de inovação.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas de negócio, times de desenvolvimento, parceiros tecnológicos e startups para transformar desafios estratégicos em soluções tecnológicas viáveis.
  • Apoiar a construção de provas de conceito (PoCs), pilotos e experimentações tecnológicas.
  • Apoiar na construção e calculo de BC para aceleração de POCs.
  • Garantir governança técnica e alinhamento arquitetural com o ecossistema de sistemas da companhia.
  • Avaliar e selecionar tecnologias, frameworks e plataformas que suportem as iniciativas de inovação.
  • Contribuir para a digitalização de processos e criação de novos produtos digitais, utilizando abordagens ágeis, low-code/no-code e automação quando aplicável.
  • Apoiar a disseminação da cultura de inovação tecnológica dentro da organização, conectando arquitetura, estratégia e geração de valor.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura de aplicações e sistemas corporativos.
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas modernas de software, incluindo microserviços, APIs, cloud computing e integração de sistemas.
  • Experiência com integração de plataformas, desenvolvimento de soluções digitais e escalabilidade de sistemas.
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções tecnológicas estruturadas.
  • Experiência trabalhando com múltiplos stakeholders, incluindo áreas de negócio, tecnologia e parceiros externos.
  • Boa comunicação, autonomia e capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos e multidisciplinares.

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência com arquitetura em ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Vivência com inovação corporativa, desenvolvimento de MVPs e experimentação tecnológica.
  • Experiência com plataformas low-code/no-code e automação de processos.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura orientada a eventos, integrações via APIs e plataformas de integração.
  • Experiência em projetos de transformação digital ou desenvolvimento de novos produtos digitais.
  • Vivência na integração com startups, parceiros tecnológicos ou ecossistemas de inovação.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis e práticas modernas de desenvolvimento de software.

Informações adicionais

  • O bem-estar das pessoas

Trabalhar na Granado é…

  • Atuar com ética, cuidado e excelência
  • Construir o futuro respeitando o passado

Juntas, Granado, Phebo e CARE representam o Grupo Granado. Onde a harmonia entre história e futuro, tradição e inovação, convida seus consumidores a viverem jornadas únicas de bem-estar e beleza responsável.
